mapper.sql: id, product_id, sku_id, activity_name, original_price, seckill_price, seckill_stock, available_stock, limit_per_user, start_time, end_time, status, allow_restock, stock_reclaimed, created_at, updated_at

a.id, a.product_id, a.sku_id, a.activity_name, a.original_price, a.seckill_price, a.seckill_stock, a.available_stock, a.limit_per_user, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status, a.allow_restock, a.stock_reclaimed, a.created_at, a.updated_at, p.name AS product_name, p.main_image AS product_image, s.spec_desc AS sku_spec_desc
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mall_seckill_activity a LEFT JOIN mall_product p ON p.id = a.product_id LEFT JOIN mall_sku s ON s.id = a.sku_id AND a.sku_id > 0 WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM mall_seckill_activity WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM mall_seckill_activity a LEFT JOIN mall_product p ON p.id = a.product_id LEFT JOIN mall_sku s ON s.id = a.sku_id AND a.sku_id > 0 WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.end_time > NOW() ORDER BY a.start_time ASC
SELECT FROM mall_seckill_activity a LEFT JOIN mall_product p ON p.id = a.product_id LEFT JOIN mall_sku s ON s.id = a.sku_id AND a.sku_id > 0 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE mall_seckill_activity SET status = 1, available_stock = #{availableStock}, stock_reclaimed = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0

UPDATE mall_seckill_activity SET available_stock = available_stock + #{quantity}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
